name: JoAi: Set Automation Actions

description.en: Replace the ordered action list (wait, warp, branch, halt) for an automation. Blocked while enrollments are active. Requires the Automations native app.
description.de: Ersetzt die Aktionsliste (wait, warp, branch, halt). Blockiert, solange Enrollments aktiv sind. Benötigt die Automations-App.
description.fr: Remplace la liste ordonnée d'actions (wait, warp, branch, halt). Bloqué tant que des enrollments sont actifs. Nécessite l'app Automations.
description.es: Sustituye la lista ordenada de acciones (wait, warp, branch, halt). Bloqueado mientras haya enrollments activos. Requiere la app Automations.
description.it: Sostituisce l'elenco ordinato di azioni (wait, warp, branch, halt). Bloccato con enrollment attivi. Richiede l'app Automations.
description.ro: Înlocuiește lista ordonată de acțiuni (wait, warp, branch, halt). Blocat cât timp există enrollment-uri active. Necesită app-ul Automations.

bot: Pass automationId and actions JSON array in order. Types: wait | warp | branch | halt. Contact messages use warpId joai-contact-message-send. Fails if any enrollment is still active.

inputs.name: Automation ID
inputs.bot: Opaque public hashid from the list or get API. Never use a numeric internal database id — only the public hashid (or slug where documented).

description.en: Public hashid (not an internal database id)

inputs.name: Actions
inputs.bot: Ordered JSON: [{"type":"wait","config":{"delayMinutes":60}},{"type":"warp","config":{"warpId":"joai-contact-message-send","inputs":{"contactId":{"source":"contact","path":"contact.id"},"message":{"source":"literal","value":"Hallo"},"subject":{"source":"literal","value":"Hi"},"integration":{"source":"literal","value":"email"},"recipientId":{"source":"contact","path":"contact.email"}}}},{"type":"halt","config":{}}]. Wait config is only delayMinutes (0 = immediate). branch: {when[], thenPosition, elsePosition}.

error.fr: Échec de la définition des actions : {{MESSAGE}}
error.es: No se pudieron definir las acciones: {{MESSAGE}}
